title: A New History for Humanity – The Human Era
summary: Kurzgesagt explains the Holocene or Human Era calendar, which adds 10,000 years to the current year to anchor dates to the start of human civilization. It argues this gives a more sensible frame for human history.
why: Linked whenever year numbering or the Holocene calendar comes up as the accessible introduction to the idea.

quote.text: Kurtzgesagt has a really great video about the subject
